description: Source code for handling Redis protocol replies, including parsing, creating, and managing reply objects (CallReply). Implements RESP3 protocol support and reply type management.

classes.name: CallReply
classes.description: Represents a parsed Redis protocol reply, supporting various reply types and nested structures.

methods.name: callReplyCreate
methods.description: Creates a new CallReply object from a reply blob, taking ownership of the reply.

methods.name: callReplyCreateError
methods.description: Creates a CallReply object representing an error reply, with deferred error list.

methods.name: callReplyGetString
methods.description: Returns the reply string or error message as a buffer.

methods.name: callReplyGetLongLong
methods.description: Returns the reply as a long long integer.

methods.name: callReplyGetDouble
methods.description: Returns the reply as a double.

methods.name: callReplyGetBool
methods.description: Returns the reply as a boolean.

methods.name: callReplyGetLen
methods.description: Returns the length of the reply.

methods.name: callReplyGetArrayElement
methods.description: Returns an array element at a specified index.

methods.name: callReplyGetSetElement
methods.description: Returns a set element at a specified index.

methods.name: callReplyGetMapElement
methods.description: Returns a map key-value pair at a specified index.

methods.name: callReplyGetAttribute
methods.description: Returns the attribute reply if exists.

methods.name: callReplyGetAttributeElement
methods.description: Returns an attribute key-value pair at a specified index.

methods.name: callReplyGetBigNumber
methods.description: Returns a big number reply value.

methods.name: callReplyGetVerbatim
methods.description: Returns a verbatim string reply and its format.

methods.name: callReplyGetProto
methods.description: Returns the raw reply blob and its length.

methods.name: callReplyGetPrivateData
methods.description: Returns the private data associated with the reply.

methods.name: callReplyIsResp3
methods.description: Checks if the reply or sub-replies are RESP3 formatted.

methods.name: callReplyDeferredErrorList
methods.description: Returns the list of deferred errors.

methods.name: callReplyType
methods.description: Returns the reply type (e.g., string, array, error).
